observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Joshua links forty years of wandering with the death of the generation that did not obey.
observations.label: A new generation

observations.body: The wilderness marks the death of one generation and the preparation of another before entry.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Joshua 5:2–8 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Forty years of delay are linked to disobedience while the children now face their own response.
payload.title: The wilderness generation and the land
